Here is a tailored Job Description: Junior AI / Machine Learning Developer designed to match the skill spectrum across these candidate resumes. It strikes an ideal balance: high-match candidates like Rohan Mehta will achieve high scores, while entry-level candidates like Priya Iyer will map as partial/medium matches.
Save the text below as a file (e.g., data/raw/AI_Dev_JD.txt or convert it to .pdf/.docx) to test your hybrid ranker and analytics engine:
Job Description: Junior AI / Machine Learning Developer
Company: TechNova Analytics
Location: Bengaluru / Remote
About the Role:
TechNova Analytics is looking for an entry-to-mid level AI / Machine Learning Developer to build and optimize NLP, RAG, and computer vision pipelines. In this role, you will work across the full ML lifecycle—from data ingestion and preprocessing to model fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and containerized API deployment.
Key Responsibilities:
Preprocess and clean structured/unstructured datasets for training and evaluation pipelines.
Develop and fine-tune NLP, transformer, and computer vision models for classification, summarization, or object detection.
Build and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications using vector databases, LangChain, or Hugging Face.
Containerize ML inference models using Docker and serve predictions via modern REST APIs (FastAPI/Flask).
Collaborate with engineering teams to monitor, benchmark, and evaluate model performance metrics.
Required Technical Skills:
Programming Languages: Python, SQL, C++
ML/DL Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers
NLP & LLM Tech: RAG Pipelines, LangChain, Embeddings, Vector Databases (FAISS, Pinecone)
Computer Vision & Tools: OpenCV, CNNs, Pandas, NumPy
Deployment & Tools: Docker, Git, FastAPI, REST APIs
Qualifications & Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.
Hands-on experience building applied ML projects or RAG/NLP prototypes.
Comfortable working across data preparation, feature extraction, and basic model deployment workflows.
